summary: Retest of the iteration 2 fixes plus a quick regression of hold/recall and the floor flows. Backend: added 22 new tests in test_iter3_fixes.py; with the existing regression suite, 32 of 32 pass. Frontend (Playwright on the public URL, demo/demo123): (1) After a cash payment, closing the dialog with Esc and, separately, with the X button now clears the cart. F2 and CHARGE then show a 'Cart is empty' toast and do not reopen the paid order. (2) The GST label shows 'GST (5%)', 'GST' for mixed rates and 'GST (18%)' correctly. (3) Recalling T2 and switching to T5, which already has a held bill, then pressing F4 is rejected with the toast 'Table T5 already has a held bill'. The cart is kept and no duplicate held bill is created. Re-parking on T2 works. (4) The floor shows '· 2 bills' on a Billed table with 2 pending orders. (5) The Reports date picker is a shadcn Popover + Calendar with no native date input. Future days are disabled, and picking a past date reloads the data and closes the popover. (6) The menu images now match their items. The only open issue: toasts are still at the bottom-right, not bottom-center as claimed, and they cover the HOLD/CHARGE buttons.

minor.issue: A Paid order can still be set to Cancelled, and the cancelled-but-paid order then drops out of the report silently with no refund record. Pre-existing behaviour; consider a guard or a refund flow.

issues: The Toaster is still position='bottom-right', not bottom-center as stated in the review request. On the POS screen, toasts cover the HOLD/CHARGE buttons and the F-key hints in the cart panel.

A single cash payment fires up to 4 stacked toasts ('Cash paid', 'Payment confirmed via Cash', 'Payment received · Cash', 'Order completed'). Consider removing the duplicates, e.g. ignore the WebSocket payment_success when status is already paid.
The Orders table 'Taxable' column shows o.subtotal, not subtotal minus discount, so it does not match the Taxable value summary when a discount exists.
The calendar's next-month arrow stays enabled even though every future date is disabled (cosmetic).

action_items: Change <Toaster position> in src/index.js to 'bottom-center' (or top-center) so toasts stop covering the POS HOLD/CHARGE buttons.
Optional: reduce the duplicate payment toasts; show (subtotal - discount) in the Reports orders 'Taxable' column; block cancelling Paid orders or add a refund flow.
critical_code_review_comments: PaymentModal onOpenChange correctly calls onPaid when status==='paid'. Fix confirmed.
_payable_order guard is applied to cash, card and UPI initiate.
The hold_order clash check is correct, both for an upsert by id and for a move to an occupied table.
POS cart total is computed on the client without a discount. That is fine today because POS has no discount input, but it will diverge if a POS discount is added.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of retested fixes (toast position claim not met)
